question.question: What is Vagabond Aid cost and target, is a crafted item required, and how are repeated Aid relationship improvements counted?

expected.expected_answer: Exhaust any ready undamaged item, give matching clearing card to player with faction pieces there. May take crafted item if present, but Aid can occur without item. For non-hostile faction meet printed Aid count within same turn per step, each Aid counts once toward one improvement; advance and score new space.

source_passages.quotation: - **Aid:** Exhaust **one face-up, undamaged item of any type**, give a card matching your clearing to player with faction pieces there, even Hostile. May then take one item from their Crafted Items box face up into Satchel/track; no available item is required to Aid. **Only non-Hostile relationships can advance through Aid; a Hostile recipient stays Hostile.** Check relationship improvement below.

Each other faction starts Indifferent. To advance a non-Hostile marker one space, Aid that faction as many times **in this same turn** as printed between current and next spaces. One Aid counts toward only one improvement. Advance and score VP printed in new space. At final space become **Allied**; each subsequent Aid to that faction scores **two VP**.

answer.ruling: Exhaust one face-up, undamaged item of any type and give a card matching your clearing to a player who has faction pieces there, even if Hostile. You may then take one item from that player’s Crafted Items box face up into Satchel or a track; an available item is not required to take the Aid action.

Aid can advance only a non-Hostile relationship. To advance one space, Aid that faction the number of times shown between the current and next spaces during the same turn. Each Aid counts for only one improvement; advance and score the VP on the new space. At Allied, each subsequent Aid scores two VP. Aid cannot move a Hostile relationship out of Hostile.
